subject: Why Walking Gets Harder with Age: The Ankle's Safety-First Trade-Off
script: From Agewell Brief: Why Walking Gets Harder with Age: The Ankle's Safety-First Trade-Off. New research reveals that aging brains sacrifice walking efficiency for stability, stiffening the ankle and increasing fatigue. Here's the biomechanics behind the shift—and how to fight it. Walking is the most fundamental human movement, yet it silently degrades with age. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
